subject: Fictional adult man and woman, narrative pencil-and-watercolour illustration; not profile photos.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original editorial illustration for SecondU's Agent Dating discovery screen; a finished artwork, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: a romantic, sophisticated encounter between two clearly adult fictional people, one man and one woman in their late twenties or thirties, drawn as small poetic figures with minimal face detail. They are approaching one another on a gently curving path through a flowering riverside garden; each holds a book. Their body language feels warm, curious and equal. A thin hand-drawn vermilion thread lightly follows the path between them as a subtle metaphor of connection.
Style/medium: beautiful hand-rendered coloured-pencil and transparent watercolour on warm ivory cotton paper. Visible pencil strokes, soft watercolour bleeds, imperfect organic contours, delicate botanical detail, generous untouched paper. Match the refined tactile art direction of an established cream-paper, cobalt foliage, vermilion poppy, muted sage editorial art collection.
Composition/framing: landscape artwork around 3:2 aspect ratio. The two adults are the clear central subject but occupy less than half the canvas; lush flowering branches at outer corners and generous breathing room. Their whole bodies fit comfortably inside the middle 70% so the illustration crops gracefully into a tall card. Keep narrative charming and readable at desktop UI size.
Color palette: warm cream paper, restrained sage and cobalt foliage, vermilion/coral flowers, muted ochre light. Romantic through composition and craft, not pink gradients.
Constraints: absolutely no photographic or photorealistic humans, no realistic portrait rendering, no stock-photo aesthetic, no 3D, no anime, no emoji, no UI chrome, no logos, no words, no letters, no watermark. Adult characters fully clothed in casual modern clothes; no sexualized posing. Draw people and environment as the same cohesive pencil-and-watercolour illustration.
